# pocketbase

Types from PocketBase's Go package `pocketbase`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [pocketbase](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase).

## pocketbase.PocketBase

Has everything <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase#coreapp">CoreApp</a></code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `rootCmd?` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/cobra#cobracommand">cobra.Command</a></code> | RootCmd is the main console command |
| `start()` | <code>(): void</code> | Start starts the application, aka. registers the default system commands (serve, superuser, version) and executes pb.RootCmd. |
| `execute()` | <code>(): void</code> | Execute initializes the application (if not already) and executes the pb.RootCmd with graceful shutdown support. |

## pocketbase.Config

Config is the PocketBase initialization config struct.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `hideStartBanner` | <code>boolean</code> | hide the default console server info on app startup |
| `defaultDev` | <code>boolean</code> | optional default values for the console flags |
| `defaultDataDir` | <code>string // if not set, it will fallback to &#34;./pb_data&#34;</code> |  |
| `defaultEncryptionEnv` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `defaultQueryTimeout` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a> // default to core.DefaultQueryTimeout (in seconds)</code> |  |
| `dataMaxOpenConns` | <code>number // default to core.DefaultDataMaxOpenConns</code> | optional DB configurations |
| `dataMaxIdleConns` | <code>number // default to core.DefaultDataMaxIdleConns</code> |  |
| `auxMaxOpenConns` | <code>number // default to core.DefaultAuxMaxOpenConns</code> |  |
| `auxMaxIdleConns` | <code>number // default to core.DefaultAuxMaxIdleConns</code> |  |
| `dbConnect` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core#coredbconnectfunc">core.DBConnectFunc</a> // default to core.dbConnect</code> |  |
